thread:
Samir: Quick proposal — start emitting slice-level signals for rollouts so the console can show side-by-side comparisons. Need runtime/router labels and quota inputs from infra. Interested in p50/p95/p99 deltas, error uplift, fallback ratio, quota throttles, queue_time, and KV cache hit. @Elaine @Dmitri?
Elaine: Sounds useful. Clarify: what do you mean by slices — per-route, per-tenant, or payload buckets?
Samir: Start with per-route + top-ten tenants by QPS + payload-length buckets (short/med/long). Also include routing_policy tag (e.g. latency_vs_cost) and quota_bucket.
Dmitri: We can add labels from the router: route_id, model_variant, policy, quota_id, tenant_id. Emitting payload_bucket needs a tiny compute step. Concern: cardinality explosion if tenant list isn't bounded.
Mara: For dashboards we should keep the slices small and deterministic. Panels: side-by-side timeseries for baseline vs canary (p50/p95/p99), error_rate uplift %, fallback_invocation_ratio, quota_throttle_count, queue_time_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate. Also show sample counts per slice.
Elaine: For alerts, propose: p99 uplift > 3% && error_rate uplift > 0.5% sustained 30m -> create regression incident. Also flag if fallback_invocation_ratio > 2x. :thinking:
Dmitri: Router can emit header tags and metric labels. We'll map them to prometheus/metricsd. infra-bot: will forward to TSDB. Adding payload_bucket on the hot path adds ~0.2% CPU. OK?
infra-bot: New metric config accepted. Example config (metrics-exporter):
```
- name: request_slice
  labels: [route_id, tenant_id, policy, payload_bucket, quota_id, canary_id]
  type: histogram
  buckets_ms: [10,50,100,200,500,1000,5000]
```
Deploy mapping to metrics pipeline required.
Jules: UX note — in rollout page allow selecting slice dimension (route/tenant/payload) and show statistical test result next to charts (p-value + uplift %). Want a compact summary card with auto-highlight for slices that fail signals.
Mara: Also capture quota metrics: per-slice quota_exhausted_count and token_consumed gauge. Without these we can't tell if errors are quota-related or model regressions.
Samir: Good call. Also want routing fallback counts (when policy routes to cheaper model) and model_fallback_reason tag.
Dmitri: Will add router metrics: fallback_count{from_variant,to_variant,reason} and routing_policy_used. Will push changes to router middleware.
Elaine: Cost visibility: show estimated cost per 1k tokens per slice so product teams can weigh latency vs cost during rollouts.
Samir: Action items: 1) Dmitri -> router labels + metric names. 2) infra -> exporter mapping + TSDB dashboard templates. 3) Product (Jules) -> console mock: slice selector + side-by-side panels. 4) Eng-platform (Samir/Mara) -> wire signals into canary job and define alerting rules. I'll open a PR with the metric list and example dashboard panels.
Dmitri: I'll aim to have router label PR by EOD Fri (ETA: 1763280000). cc @infra-bot
infra-bot: Deploy ticket created: INF-2024; staging ETA 1763280000; prod after validation.
Samir: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
